Guide

Interview transcription on your phone

Verbi is an interview transcription app for iPhone and Android: record the interview on your phone or import the audio, and Verbi writes out the whole conversation in any of 39 languages, with each speaker told apart on Pro. It’s free to start, with 60 minutes of transcription a month, enough to try it on a real interview.

Free to download, with 60 minutes of transcription every month.

Last updated: October 19, 2026

How do I transcribe an interview?

  1. Ask your interviewee for permission to record, and get their yes on the recording.
  2. Before you start, add names, places and technical terms to Custom Vocabulary in Settings.
  3. Put the phone between you and your interviewee and tap Record & Transcribe. If you recorded on another device, import the file or share it to Verbi.
  4. With Pro, Verbi separates the voices. Set the Number of Speakers if you know how many people take part.
  5. When the transcript is ready, search for the quotes you need. With Pro, give each voice a name.
  6. With Pro, export the transcript as TXT or PDF, or turn it into a first draft with the Blog Post template. On the free plan, copy the text.

What does the interview transcript include?

  • The whole conversation as text, from start to finish, with timestamps.
  • Each speaker’s words kept apart and named (speaker detection is part of Pro).
  • Search across all your interviews for any word that was said.
  • With Pro, answers to questions like “What did she say about funding?”, drawn from the interview itself.
  • Interviews in 39 languages, with translation into English, Turkish, German, French or Spanish on Pro.
  • Summaries from templates such as Blog Post or Idea Capture that keep to what was actually said (choosing a template is part of Pro).

How do I get a transcript I can quote from?

  • Record in a quiet room and keep both voices at a similar distance from the phone.
  • Try not to talk over each other. Overlapping speech is the hardest part of any recording to transcribe.
  • Check every quote against the recording before you publish it. A transcript is where you start, not your final source.
  • On the free plan, recordings are kept for 15 days: copy the text you want to keep, or go Pro to export TXT or PDF and keep everything.

Is Verbi free for interview transcription?

You can start free. The free plan includes 60 minutes of transcription a month, recordings kept for 15 days, live transcription (basic on iPhone) and one automatic AI summary. Verbi Pro adds speaker detection, unlimited transcription and summaries, translation, chat with the transcript, export and unlimited history.

Recordings and transcripts are stored on your phone. To transcribe, the audio is sent to our speech-to-text providers (ElevenLabs and OpenAI), usually through our server, and summaries and chat send the transcript text to OpenAI. The privacy policy lists what is sent and where.

Frequently asked questions

Can Verbi transcribe an interview I recorded somewhere else?

Yes. Import the audio file, or share it to Verbi from the app it’s in. It counts toward the same monthly minutes as a recording made in Verbi.

Can it show who said what?

Yes, with Pro. Verbi separates the voices, and you can give each one a name.

Can I transcribe interviews in another language?

Yes. Verbi transcribes 39 languages and detects the language on its own. With Pro, you can translate the transcript into English, Turkish, German, French or Spanish.
